note: Calibration set for the LLM judge. `author_label` is what the outputs were written to be (AI-authored, NOT ground truth). Fill `human_label` with pass/fail yourself, then run scripts/calibrate_judge.py. Disagreement on more than 1-2 samples means the rubric in evals/evaluators.py is wrong and every judged score is noise.
